title: Structural and Magnetic Analysis of a Family of Structurally Related Iron(III)-Oxo Clusters of Metal Nuclearity Fe8, Fe12Ca4, and Fe12La4

material_class.structural_family: Fe12La4 iron(III)-oxo cluster with two stacked Fe4 butterfly units, end Fe2 pairs, and side La3+ ions

synthesis.procedure: Method A (aerobic): to a stirred colourless solution of tbbH (0.71 g, 4.0 mmol) in PhCN (10 mL) in a microwave reaction vial was added NEt3 (0.56 mL, 4.0 mmol), followed by Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.40 g, 1.0 mmol) and La(NO3)3·6H2O (0.43 g, 1.0 mmol), giving a brown solution. After stirring 5 min at room temperature, the sealed vial was heated at 140 °C in a microwave reactor for 1 h. After cooling, the near-black solution was mixed with CH2Cl2 (5 mL), filtered, layered with MeCN, and left undisturbed for 3 days to give orange-red crystals of 3·5PhCN. Yield ~15% based on Fe. Method B: the same microwave procedure in MeCN (15 mL) instead of PhCN; a yellow-orange precipitate was collected, washed with MeCN, dissolved in CH2Cl2 (10 mL), and layered with an equal volume of EtOH. After two days, orange-red crystals of 3 were obtained (IR match to Method A). Yield ~45% based on Fe.
synthesis.temperature: microwave heating at 140 °C (after 5 min stirring at room temperature); crystallization at ambient temperature
synthesis.time: 1 h microwave heating; 3 days crystallization (Method A); 2 days crystallization (Method B)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: microwave reaction vial, sealed; Method A in PhCN, Method B in MeCN
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Method A: cool, mix with CH2Cl2 (5 mL), filter, layer with MeCN, crystallize 3 days as 3·5PhCN, wash with Me2CO, dry under vacuum. Method B: collect yellow-orange precipitate, wash with MeCN, dissolve in CH2Cl2 (10 mL), layer with equal volume of EtOH, crystallize 2 days, wash with Me2CO, dry under vacuum.
synthesis.yield: ~15% based on Fe (Method A); ~45% based on Fe (Method B)

properties.summary: Vacuum-dried 3·4H2O shows strong antiferromagnetic coupling in the central Fe8 subunit (local S = 0) with ferromagnetic coupling in each end Fe2 pair (local S = 5). χMT rises well above the two-independent-S = 5 spin-only value at low T, attributed to intermolecular ferromagnetic interactions via near-perpendicular 4-tBu-benzoate contacts. AC in-phase data confirm the high low-T χMT is not a dc-field artifact.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: dc, 0.1 T (1.0 kG), 300 K, vacuum-dried 3·4H2O restrained in eicosane

measurements.name: χ'MT
measurements.conditions: ac in-phase plateau at 6–10 K; 3.5 G ac field, 1000 Hz, no applied dc field, 1.8–15.0 K range
